name: Brand Identity Kit
purpose: A reusable structure for delivering a brand's visual identity. Every page reads from styles.css; swap the tokens below and the whole kit re-renders in the new brand.

demonstrationBrand.name: Jamrah
demonstrationBrand.note: Demonstration content only. Replace with the brand being delivered.

color.note: Every swatch carries four codes. PMS is not optional — CMYK drifts between print runs, Pantone does not.
color.derivation: The category clustered in blue, green and yellow. Moving up the wheel toward red-orange produced the accent. The palette is the competitor method's output, not a taste call.

latin.heading: Georgia, 'Source Serif 4', serif
latin.note: Stands in for a licensed display serif. Replace with the brand's real face and always name a fallback.

arabic.heading: 'Noto Naskh Arabic', 'Segoe UI', serif
arabic.note: Arabic is set separately, never as a fallback slot on a Latin face.

type.fallbackRule: Every typeface names a fallback. Without one the guideline breaks the moment someone opens a document without the licensed font.

logo.clearSpaceUnit: X = the height of the symbol
